rainfall_provider: Open-Meteo / ERA5 reanalysis; not IMD observations
forecast_horizon: Next scheduled CGWB survey round, 2–4 months
selection: Lowest 2022 validation MAE; configuration fixed before inspecting this pilot test output

colours.red: Critical historical depth anomaly: estimate exceeds same-station/same-season training 90th percentile; experimental, not a confirmed crisis
colours.amber: Estimate above training 75th percentile but not 90th
colours.green: Estimate at or below training 75th percentile; not a safe-water claim
colours.grey: Fewer than four training readings for this station/season

limitations: No matched next-round Yavatmal pairs were available in 2021; 2022 is used for validation.
2023 has been inspected previously; exploratory backtest, not an untouched final benchmark.
Rainfall is gridded reanalysis at nearest cells, not measured at the wells.
Statistical anomaly labels are not validated hydrological crisis labels.
No future precipitation is used; rolling windows end before the forecast-origin day.
Prediction intervals are empirical; report actual test coverage rather than promising 90%.
